title: Probe Response / Raw Run Manifest v0
$comment: PROVISIONAL — AUDIT INFRASTRUCTURE ONLY. The raw run manifest a probe returns on stdout (DevSpec Section 30 and Section 42). It captures WHAT HAPPENED at the runtime, with paths to raw artifacts. A probe must NOT decide whether the lane passed an ALMS invariant, and must NOT rewrite a failed call into a fake success. This is the raw truth; it is NOT the normalized transcript.

retry_count_observed.$comment: null when the probe cannot measure framework-internal retries; NOT silently coerced to 0.

timeout_or_cancellation_action.$comment: Local cancellation != provider definitely stopped. This records the CLIENT-side action only.

capture_kind.$comment: Which native shape was captured; selects the harness normalizer branch.

execution_mode.$comment: offline_mock evidence is a mock simulation and must NEVER be labelled live evidence.
